\\\"unknowns\\\": missing,\\n        }\\n\\n    eligible = []\\n    require_verified = policy.get(\\\"require_verified\\\", False)\\n    for record in evidence:\\n        if record.get(\\\"claim\\\") record.get(\\\"source\\\")\\n    }\\n    eligible = [record for record in eligible if record.get(\\\"source\\\") not in superseded]\\n\\n    if not eligible:\\n        return {\\n            \\\"status\\\": \\\"unknown\\\",\\n            \\\"value\\\": None,\\n            \\\"sources\\\": [],\\n            \\\"unknowns\\\": [\\\"no matching evidence\\\"],\\n        }\\n\\n    sources = sorted(record[\\\"source\\\"] for record in eligible)\\n    canonical_values = {}\\n    for record in eligible:\\n        value = record.get(\\\"value\\\")\\n        canonical_values.setdefault(_canonical_json(value), value)\\n\\n    if len(canonical_values) != 1:\\n        return {\\n            \\\"status\\\": \\\"conflict\\\",\\n            \\\"value\\\":
